No size reference, model number, or rear panel shot to confirm which PS4 variant this is.
No region sticker, serial plate, or power adapter plug type visible.
Console is fully wrapped in clear plastic, hiding any wear, scratches, or dents.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or function correctly
risks.proof: A video clip showing the console powering on and loading a game or the home screen.

risks.risk: Accessories (controller, power cable, HDMI) may be missing or non-original
risks.proof: A clear photo of all included accessories laid out next to the console.
A photo of the system settings storage screen or the rear label listing capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest common capacity (e.g., 500GB).

risks.risk: Region/model mismatch (Japan import may have different plug, firmware, or disc region lock)
risks.proof: A photo of the rear panel model number and power adapter plug type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as import-risk unit, discounted for potential incompatibility.

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage under plastic wrap
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the unwrapped console body from multiple angles.

risks.risk: Console could be modded, jailbroken, or have altered firmware
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system software version/settings screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as modded unit (lower resale value, warranty risk).

risks.risk: Claimed games may not exist, be pirated, or be digital-only without transferable accounts
risks.proof: A photo of physical game discs/cases or a screenshot of the digital game library tied to a transferable account.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console with zero included games.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game
Photo of all accessories laid out together
Photo of the rear panel showing model number, serial, and region/plug type
Unwrapped close-up photos of the console body from all angles
Screenshot of system settings showing storage capacity and firmware version
Photo of the physical game discs or digital game library screen
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a game console, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly import, console-only unit pending the listed proofs; the seller's specific PS4/Japan/accessories/games claims remain unverified or unverifiable remotely.
